doc: A requirement document, CRLF endings, without an Assessments heading: the section assessments does not exist, and the document reads no assessment and reports nothing (FBL 4.8, Sections).

steps.doc: The first assessment of a file without the section (the operation addAssessment on REQ-0001): the container assessments is created by the insert's create, at end-of-document with the text ## Assessments, one ensure-container at the end of the body that writes a line ending, the heading and a line ending, so that a blank line stands before the heading; the assessment follows at the same offset as the first item of a section that holds none, after a line ending, so that a blank line stands before it, with the marker - at column 0 (FBL 6.2, 6.3, a missing section; R7). Every line break is the body's CRLF. The checkbox is written open, as in the add of the fixture beside this one.

attributes.text: Is 30 minutes right for the mobile app?

splices.text: - [ ] Question REQ-0001: Is 30 minutes right for the mobile app?

steps.expect:

steps.doc: Undo puts back exactly the bytes the edit replaced: the assessment and the heading go, and the document is the input again.
